answer: Resist sybils with staked web-of-trust vouching: a newcomer gains standing only when established peers each lock a bond naming that specific agent. If it is later judged a fake, every voucher's stake is slashed. Reputation becomes a pearl earned through endorsers risking real capital, never minted free. A clone farm cannot vouch for itself, so 1,000 cheap clones demand 1,000 separate at-risk bonds; honest peers watch like a falcon and refuse to back a sable-dark stranger whose exposure would burn their own stake. Admitting one caught sybil costs more than it can ever extract.
